notes: The primary Fandom Entities page displayed 45 row candidates during the source check. Frog King is added as a 46th row because it has a source-backed boss page and is a player-facing Frog Cave encounter.
Admin Entities is excluded as an aggregate row. Mega Cultist and Evil Bunny are included as individual special rows because source pages list them as meaningful encounter entities.
Tameability is summarized only; full food, flute, and step requirements belong to the separate tameable animals catalog.
Values shown with question marks or TBA in source pages are not copied into exact stat fields.

Mossy Mammoth image is now resolved from the Fandom file imageinfo endpoint. Tool Trader uses the Blacksmith appearance image because its source page explicitly states Tool Trader has the Blacksmith class appearance and no direct NPC image is available.

items.name: The Deer
items.location: Forest at night; campfire area when the fire is out
items.spawnCondition: Night threat tied to the campfire safe zone and the missing children objective.
items.bestAction: Stay near a lit campfire, use the flashlight stun window when needed, and do not treat it like a normal kill target.
items.damage: 25+; source says it varies by day and hunger
items.walkspeed: 35+; source says it can get faster during longer chases
items.sourceNote: Major monster row kept separate because it changes night routing and rescue pressure.

items.name: The Owl
items.spawnCondition: Can replace The Deer as the active night monster.
items.bestAction: Stop moving during the detection minigame, then use flashlight stun only after a chase starts.
items.damage: 25+; source says it varies by day
items.sourceNote: Source notes wolves can spawn to force movement during its encounter.

items.name: The Ram
items.spawnCondition: One of the possible secondary monsters depending on biome conditions.
items.bestAction: Sidestep its charge, use flashlight while it is walking rather than charging, and avoid relying on trees as permanent cover.
items.damage: 25+; source says it varies by day
items.sourceNote: Source describes a charge attack and tree-destroying behavior.

items.name: The Bat
items.location: Underground areas, Bat Cave, and Caverns
items.spawnCondition: Cave-only major threat.
items.bestAction: Hide behind cover during the screech cue; flashlight stun is not listed as a counter.
items.walkspeed: Flies; no numeric walk speed listed
items.sourceNote: Source describes it as blind and not flashlight-stunnable.

items.name: The Cat
items.spawnCondition: Major monster encounter with a pounce attack.
items.bestAction: Keep spacing for the pounce and avoid committing to narrow routes before its attack is clear.
items.sourceNote: Source gives damage and speed as uncertain, so exact values are intentionally blank.

items.name: Cultist King
items.location: Cultist King Palace in the Volcanic Biome
items.spawnCondition: Summoned by placing four Cultist Gems on the palace pedestals; source says once per day.
items.drops: Mossy Coins, Cultist King Antler, Volcanic Bear Trap Tablet, and one infernal weapon or sack reward
items.bestAction: Prepare ranged damage and an exit plan before summoning; use the palace doorway, high ground, or lava trap route rather than face-tanking.
items.hp: Huge health pool; no exact value listed
items.sourceNote: The detailed boss section is on the Volcanic Biome page rather than a complete standalone page.

items.name: Frog King
items.role: Frog Cave boss guarding the Frog Chest
items.spawnCondition: Appears as the boss of the Frog Cave during Frog Invasion content.
items.drops: No direct drop list found; defeating it opens the route to Frog Chest rewards
items.bestAction: Clear space before killing it because the source says it spawns weaker frogs after death.
items.availability: Active source page; tied to Frog Invasion content
items.sourceNote: Source marks health as uncertain, so the exact HP is blank.

items.name: Melee Cultist
items.location: Cultist bases, strongholds, raids, camps, trees, temples, and related cultist locations
items.spawnCondition: Appears as part of cultist groups and campfire raids.
items.drops: Mossy Coins, ammo, cultist body, and possible cultist-family rewards depending on location or event
items.bestAction: Kite or fight from range, especially during raids where melee enemies can stack around camp defenses.
items.hp: 100-150 in many natural/raid encounters; stronghold variants scale by level
items.damage: 7 with Old Axe; 15 with Spear; 30 with Morningstar
items.sourceNote: Cultist source lists broad spawn, HP, damage, and drops by cultist family.

items.name: Crossbow Cultist
items.location: Cultist bases, strongholds, raids, camps, trees, temples, and related cultist locations
items.spawnCondition: Appears in cultist groups and raids, especially where ranged pressure matters.
items.drops: Mossy Coins, ammo, cultist body, and possible cultist-family rewards depending on location or event
items.bestAction: Rush or line-of-sight it before dealing with slower melee enemies, since source tips call out ranged cultists as dangerous but weak up close.
items.hp: 100-150 in many natural/raid encounters; stronghold variants scale by level
items.sourceNote: Kept separate from melee cultists because ranged pressure changes raid priority.

items.name: Juggernaut Cultist
items.spawnCondition: Appears as a stronger cultist variant.
items.bestAction: Do not let it pin the campfire route; use range, traps, or team focus before lighter enemies overwhelm the base.
items.hp: Source lists cultist health ranges, but no clean unique Juggernaut HP was verified
items.sourceNote: Included because the source treats Juggernaut as a named cultist variant, but exact unique stats were not cleanly separated.

items.name: Wolf
items.role: Early hostile animal and pelt source
items.location: Forest, Snow, Volcanic areas, locked caves, and cabins
items.spawnCondition: Common night and guardian enemy; source also lists locked cave guardians.
items.drops: Morsel 2-3, Steak 1, Wolf Pelt 0-1; guardian wolves can drop Red Key
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists a Steak or Morsel route. Full feeding steps belong to tameable animals.
items.bestAction: Fight from range or tame only when you have the right flute and food; watch for guardian key versions in caves.
items.sourceNote: Wolf row covers the canonical entity; plural and generic wolf aliases are merged here.

items.name: Alpha Wolf
items.role: Stronger wolf and better pelt source
items.location: Forest, any biome at higher campfire level, locked cave 2, and Cultist Hunter Camp
items.spawnCondition: Source lists campfire level 3+ conditions and guardian versions.
items.drops: Morsel 2-3, Steak 1, Alpha Wolf Pelt 0-1; guardian alpha wolves can drop Blue Key
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Good Flute or better with Steak, Mackerel, or Salmon routes.
items.bestAction: Treat it as a faster wolf; kite or tame only when prepared with stronger flute and food.
items.sourceNote: Lowercase and plural aliases are merged into this canonical row.

items.name: Bear
items.role: Heavy animal threat and pelt source
items.location: Forest, Cultist Hunter Camp, and locked caves
items.spawnCondition: Source lists campfire level 5+ for forest spawns, with some Cultist Hunter Camp exceptions.
items.drops: Morsel 6, Steak 3-4, Bear Pelt 0-1; guardian bears can drop Yellow or Grey Key
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Steak, Pumpkin, or Salmon routes.
items.bestAction: Avoid early fights; use range, traps, or taming prep because it has much higher HP and damage than wolves.
items.sourceNote: Exact spawn level has a source caveat for Cultist Hunter Camp bear appearances.

items.name: Polar Bear
items.location: Snow Biome and Polar Bear Cave
items.spawnCondition: Source lists Snow Biome level 4+ and notes older forest/snowy patch behavior.
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Rib, Stew, or Swordfish routes.
items.bestAction: Do not enter snow routes under-geared; kite or tame with high-tier preparation.
items.sourceNote: Availability kept current to the source page rather than older spawn notes.

items.name: Aliens
items.spawnCondition: Source says UFO events can begin at night from Day 3 and one green-glow UFO leads to the Mothership.
items.drops: No clean shared drop list verified
items.bestAction: Bring weapons for ranged and melee alien gear; treat Alien Elites as keycard blockers rather than normal animals.
items.availability: Active source page; tied to alien event route
items.hp: Medium in source; no exact value listed
items.sourceNote: Source lists alien weapons and elite keycard role but not a clean exact HP or drop table.

items.name: Arctic Fox
items.spawnCondition: Source lists Snow Biome level 2+ and groups up to 2-5.
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Steak and Chili route details.
items.bestAction: Respect its speed in groups; kite before harvesting pelts or attempt taming when prepared.
items.sourceNote: Arctic fox casing aliases are merged into this row.

items.name: Frogs
items.role: Pond and Frog Cave enemy chain
items.location: Forest ponds, Jungle, Frog Cave, and pond locations
items.spawnCondition: Source says they emerge from ponds after about 10 minutes and do not appear every run.
items.tamingRequirement: Only green frogs are listed as tameable; source lists Old Flute and Mackerel summary.
items.bestAction: Avoid triggering a bad chain in tight space; killed frogs can spawn weaker frogs, so clear the area deliberately.
items.availability: Active source page; tied to Frog Invasion content
items.damage: 5 plus poison effect noted by source
items.sourceNote: Source marks HP as uncertain and describes several frog colors under one encounter family.

items.name: Scorpion
items.spawnCondition: Source lists regular volcanic spawns and faster Scorpion Nest versions.
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Steak and Morsel route details.
items.bestAction: Do not ignore poison ticks; keep distance or clear them before looting volcanic routes.
items.sourceNote: Poison damage is described separately from the listed attack damage.

items.name: Hellephant
items.location: Volcanic Biome and Hellephant Ritual Circle
items.spawnCondition: Source says it can respawn after two days.
items.drops: Cooked Steak 8-9, Cooked Ribs 0-2, Mammoth Tusk 0-1
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Pumpkin and Cake summary.
items.bestAction: Treat it as a hostile high-HP mammoth: use strong weapons, space, or taming prep before engaging.
items.sourceNote: Also called Lava Mammoth in some source text; normalized to Hellephant.

items.name: Meteor Crab
items.location: Meteor Crater and Meteor Tool Workshop
items.spawnCondition: Source says three Meteor Crabs inhabit the Meteor Tool Workshop.
items.bestAction: Clear them before looting the workshop because the meteor route depends on the crater/tool-workshop area.
items.availability: Active source page; tied to Meteor Event content
items.sourceNote: Source marks some attack and morsel values as uncertain, so only clean shard drops are used.

items.name: Shadow Cultist
items.spawnCondition: Appears in cave routes.
items.bestAction: Handle it as a cave ambush threat and do not expect material drops for the fight.
items.sourceNote: Source lists Shadow Dagger use and no drops.

items.name: Brute Cultist
items.spawnCondition: Source says it appears in deeper or final cave contexts where it can replace Shadow Cultists.
items.bestAction: Do not trade hits unless heavily geared; use range or group focus because its HP and damage are high.
items.sourceNote: Source text sometimes names this variant Brutal Cultist; normalized to Brute Cultist.

items.name: Darkstring Cultist
items.location: Underground caves and Hard Mode raids
items.spawnCondition: Appears in advanced cultist/cave content.
items.bestAction: Prioritize cover and close the angle carefully; source says it fires two bolts and reloads faster.
items.damage: High; no exact numeric value listed
items.walkspeed: Medium; no exact numeric value listed
items.sourceNote: Exact damage and speed are descriptive in the source, not clean numeric fields.

items.name: Boar
items.spawnCondition: Source lists Jungle spawns.
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Old Flute or better with Corn and Morsel summary.
items.bestAction: Treat it as a jungle threat and food source, but do not rely on unverified exact combat stats.
items.sourceNote: Source marks HP as uncertain and damage/walkspeed as TBA, so exact stats are blank.

items.name: Poison Spear Jungle Cultist
items.role: Melee jungle cultist with poison armor
items.spawnCondition: Appears in Jungle cultist encounters.
items.bestAction: Avoid melee chip damage from poison armor and use range when possible.
items.damage: 30/45 listed for Jungle Cultists; source does not split by weapon
items.sourceNote: Separated from Blowpipe Jungle Cultist because weapon and player response differ, though the source shares stats.

items.name: Blowpipe Jungle Cultist
items.role: Ranged jungle cultist with poison armor
items.spawnCondition: Appears in Jungle cultist encounters.
items.bestAction: Use cover and close safely; treat poison armor as a reason to avoid careless melee hits.
items.damage: 30/45 listed for Jungle Cultists; source does not split by weapon
items.sourceNote: Separated from Poison Spear Jungle Cultist because weapon and player response differ, though the source shares stats.

items.name: Bunny
items.role: Early food, foot drop, and taming target
items.spawnCondition: Common passive animal spawn.
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Old Flute or better and Carrot.
items.bestAction: Farm for early food or Bunny Foot, or tame when you are ready to spend carrots.
items.sourceNote: Bunnies and Rabbit aliases are merged into this canonical Bunny row.

items.name: Horse
items.spawnCondition: Spawns only with the Furniture Trader wagon according to source notes.
items.bestAction: Avoid killing it unless you need the meat; source says the wagon disappears but the Furniture Trader can still trade.
items.sourceNote: Source marks Horse health as uncertain, so exact HP is blank.

items.name: Kiwi
items.spawnCondition: Source lists campfire level 6 Kiwi Burrow condition.
items.bestAction: Carry it like a rescue target or tame it; do not try to farm drops.
items.sourceNote: Source describes Kiwi as invincible and carryable.

items.name: Turkey
items.location: Autumnal Patch and lobby-related Thanksgiving source contexts
items.spawnCondition: Thanksgiving event-origin animal; source currently marks it temporarily gone.
items.bestAction: Treat it as an event-origin row, not a normal active farm target.
items.sourceNote: Trivia suggests some legacy access may exist through Thanksgiving Flame, so availability is kept cautious.

items.name: Chick
items.location: Easter forest and Easter decoration spawns
items.spawnCondition: Event-origin animal tied to Easter content in source.
items.bestAction: Use it as a tameable/event-origin row rather than a normal drop farm.
items.sourceNote: Source does not mark it as temporarily gone, but its spawn context is event-origin.

items.name: Mammoth
items.spawnCondition: Source lists Snow Biome level 4+ and respawn after a day.
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Pumpkin and Cake summary.
items.bestAction: Leave it alone unless you are prepared to tame or kill a tanky neutral target.
items.sourceNote: Woolly Mammoth and regular Mammoth references are merged into this row.

items.name: Mossy Mammoth
items.spawnCondition: Source lists Jungle Biome level 4+ and respawn after a day.
items.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Pumpkin and Cake summary.
items.bestAction: Avoid provoking it unless the group is ready for a tanky knockback fight or a taming route.
items.sourceNote: Mossy Mammoth source image resolved through Fandom File:Mossy_Mammoth.png imageinfo after article parse returned no article images.

items.name: Dino Kid
items.spawnCondition: First missing child; source notes reveal around campfire level 2 or sometimes level 3.
items.drops: Rescue progress; rescuing a child increases the day counter by 1
items.bestAction: Clear the five red-collar wolf guards, then carry the child back to camp.
items.sourceNote: Included as a row because name, cave, order, guardian set, and rescue value differ by child.

items.name: Kraken Kid
items.spawnCondition: Second missing child; source notes reveal around campfire level 4 or sometimes level 5.
items.drops: Rescue progress; rescuing a child increases the day counter by 1
items.bestAction: Bring the blue key route prep, clear four blue-collar alpha wolves, then carry the child back.
items.sourceNote: Included as a row because name, cave, order, guardian set, and rescue value differ by child.

items.name: Squid Kid
items.spawnCondition: Third missing child; source notes reveal around campfire level 5 or sometimes level 6.
items.drops: Rescue progress; rescuing a child increases the day counter by 1
items.bestAction: Prepare for two yellow-collar bear guards before committing to the cave rescue.
items.sourceNote: Included as a row because name, cave, order, guardian set, and rescue value differ by child.

items.name: Koala Kid
items.spawnCondition: Final missing child; source notes campfire level 6 and six black-collar bear guards.
items.drops: Rescue progress; rescuing a child increases the day counter by 1
items.bestAction: Treat this as the hardest rescue cave and enter with bear-fight tools, healing, and a carry route.
items.sourceNote: Included as a row because name, cave, order, guardian set, and rescue value differ by child.

items.name: Pelt Trader
items.location: Near campfire and Missing Child board
items.spawnCondition: First appears Day 2, then source says every 3-4 days and leaves at night.
items.drops: Trades Bunny Foot, Wolf Pelt, Alpha Wolf Pelt, and Bear Pelt for upgrade choices
items.bestAction: Save pelts and visit before night if you want upgrades instead of raw material storage.
items.sourceNote: Hunter class level 3 can add an extra wolf-pelt trade according to source notes.

items.name: Furniture Trader
items.spawnCondition: May arrive on the map and travels with the Horse.
items.bestAction: Bring Mossy Coins when you want furniture; do not confuse the trader with the Horse's meat drop.
items.sourceNote: Horse and Furniture Trader are separate rows because one is a passive animal and one is the shop interaction.

items.name: Fairy
items.location: Outside Mushroom House in the Fairy Biome
items.spawnCondition: Appears at the Mushroom House with nearby flower garden context.
items.drops: Sells seed boxes for Flowers; source lists prices rising by 20 after each purchase
items.bestAction: Farm flowers before visiting so the trip can turn into seed boxes immediately.
items.sourceNote: Kept as helper/trader because the row value is the Flower exchange, not combat.

items.name: Bird Watcher
items.spawnCondition: Source says this NPC is no longer in the game.
items.drops: Formerly offered Fuel Canisters for Feathers and Gem of the Forest Fragment after enough Feathers
items.bestAction: Do not route around this NPC in normal runs; keep the row only to prevent stale-guide confusion.
items.sourceNote: Included only because removed NPC rows help players avoid stale guide instructions.

items.name: Tool Trader
items.spawnCondition: Source lists Fire level 3.
items.drops: Sells Fishing Rods and Taming Flutes for 20 Mossy Coins; includes an upgrade stand for tools
items.bestAction: Bring Mossy Coins when you need fishing or flute progression; do not expect a combat drop.
items.availability: Active source page; page is a stub
items.sourceNote: Tool Trader page is a stub with no direct NPC image. The page states Tool Trader uses the Blacksmith class appearance, so the local image uses the source-backed Blacksmith appearance render.
items.imageStatus: local appearance image present (Blacksmith.png; source says Tool Trader has Blacksmith appearance)

items.name: Happy The Halloween Guy
items.location: Halloween lobby or carnival source context
items.spawnCondition: Halloween event-origin NPC; source currently marks it temporarily gone.
items.drops: Halloween shop interaction; no combat drops
items.bestAction: Treat as a stale-guide clarity row unless Halloween content returns.
items.sourceNote: Kept special because it is meaningful row-level NPC context without creating an event catalog.

items.name: Christmas Elves
items.spawnCondition: Christmas-exclusive passive NPCs; source currently marks them temporarily gone.
items.drops: Yellow Present reward after rescue with required special tools
items.bestAction: Do not plan a normal run around them unless the Christmas event returns.
items.sourceNote: Included as row-level stale-guide clarity for an event rescue NPC group.

items.name: Mega Cultist
items.spawnCondition: Source says it can only be spawned manually by developers during update parties.
items.drops: No normal player-facing drop table verified
items.bestAction: Do not treat this as a normal run goal; it is useful mostly for identifying admin/update-party footage.
items.sourceNote: Source mentions extreme damage, but exact damage varies or conflicts, so the numeric field is blank.

items.name: Evil Bunny
items.location: Forest, Easter Bunny's Egg House, and campfire level 6 source context
items.spawnCondition: Source says it spawns after stealing the egg in Easter content.
items.drops: Ruby Chest reward when the egg is returned
items.bestAction: Treat as event-only/temporarily gone; source says it cannot be stunned.
items.sourceNote: Included as an event-exclusive monster row because it affects stale guide interpretation.
